package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"
	"unsafe"

	win "golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const earlyBootstrapLimit = 16 << 10
const earlyBootstrapPending = uint32(0x103)

type earlyBootstrapToken struct {
	SID              string
	AuthenticationID uint64
	SessionID        uint32
}
type earlyBootstrapRequest struct {
	Nonce            string
	Root             string
	ParentPID        int
	Executable       string
	ExecutableSHA256 string
	Token            earlyBootstrapToken
}
type earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt struct {
	RootOpened, CloseAttempted, RootClosed, Pending, PinsRetained bool
	OpenAccess, OpenShare, OpenFlags                              uint32
	IOSBSize, IOSBAlignment, IOSBInformationOffset                uint64
	ReturnedStatus                                                uint32
	IOSBPresent                                                   bool
	IOSBStatus, Information                                       uint64
	RawBufferHex                                                  string
	Flags, MaximumComponentLength                                 uint32
	FilesystemName                                                string
	Error, CloseError                                             string
}
type earlyBootstrapChildReceipt struct {
	Nonce                        string
	Root                         string
	PID, ParentPID               int
	Executable, ExecutableSHA256 string
	Token                        earlyBootstrapToken
	Native                       earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt
	Error                        string
}
type earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt struct {
	Stdout, Stderr                                            []byte
	Nonce, Root, Executable, ExecutableSHA256                 string
	ParentPID, PID                                            int
	ParentToken, ChildToken                                   earlyBootstrapToken
	Started, Exited, WaitReturned                             time.Time
	ExitConfirmed, KillRequested, KillAttempted, KillReturned bool
	ExitCode                                                  int
	KillError, WaitError, Outcome, Error                      string
	InputBytes, OutputBytes                                   int
	OutputComplete                                            bool
	OwnerRetained                                             bool
	Native                                                    *earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt
	owner                                                     *earlyBootstrapProcessOwner
}

type earlyBootstrapIOSB struct{ Status, Information uintptr }
type earlyBootstrapNativeOwner struct {
	iosb      *earlyBootstrapIOSB
	buffer    *[4096]byte
	pins      runtime.Pinner
	closeRoot func() error
	receipt   earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt
}

var earlyBootstrapPendingOwner *earlyBootstrapNativeOwner

func earlyBootstrapDecode(info uint64, data []byte) (uint32, uint32, string, error) {
	if info < 12 || info > 4096 || info > uint64(len(data)) {
		return 0, 0, "", errors.New("bootstrap information length outside fixed buffer")
	}
	data = data[:int(info)]
	flags, component, n := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[4:]), binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[8:])
	if n&1 != 0 || uint64(n)+12 != info {
		return 0, 0, "", errors.New("bootstrap filesystem name length is incomplete")
	}
	units := make([]uint16, int(n)/2)
	for i := range units {
		units[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[12+2*i:])
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(units); i++ {
		u := units[i]
		if u >= 0xd800 && u <= 0xdbff {
			if i+1 == len(units) || units[i+1] < 0xdc00 || units[i+1] > 0xdfff {
				return 0, 0, "", errors.New("bootstrap filesystem name has invalid UTF-16")
			}
			i++
		} else if u >= 0xdc00 && u <= 0xdfff {
			return 0, 0, "", errors.New("bootstrap filesystem name has invalid UTF-16")
		}
	}
	name := string(utf16.Decode(units))
	if flags != 0x406 || component != 255 || name != "remote-fs" {
		return flags, component, name, errors.New("bootstrap filesystem attributes differ from fixture")
	}
	return flags, component, name, nil
}

func earlyBootstrapPerformNative(owner *earlyBootstrapNativeOwner, query func(*earlyBootstrapIOSB, *[4096]byte) uint32) (earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt, error) {
	owner.receipt.IOSBSize = uint64(unsafe.Sizeof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}))
	owner.receipt.IOSBAlignment = uint64(unsafe.Alignof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}))
	owner.receipt.IOSBInformationOffset = uint64(unsafe.Offsetof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}.Information))
	if owner.receipt.IOSBSize != 16 || owner.receipt.IOSBAlignment != 8 || owner.receipt.IOSBInformationOffset != 8 {
		return owner.receipt, errors.New("bootstrap IO_STATUS_BLOCK ABI differs")
	}
	owner.iosb = new(earlyBootstrapIOSB)
	owner.buffer = new([4096]byte)
	owner.pins.Pin(owner.iosb)
	owner.pins.Pin(owner.buffer)
	owner.receipt.ReturnedStatus = query(owner.iosb, owner.buffer)
	runtime.KeepAlive(owner)
	if owner.receipt.ReturnedStatus == earlyBootstrapPending {
		owner.receipt.Pending = true
		owner.receipt.PinsRetained = true
		owner.receipt.Error = "bootstrap_unexpected_pending"
		earlyBootstrapPendingOwner = owner
		return owner.receipt, errors.New(owner.receipt.Error)
	}
	owner.receipt.IOSBPresent = true
	owner.receipt.IOSBStatus = uint64(owner.iosb.Status)
	owner.receipt.Information = uint64(owner.iosb.Information)
	if owner.receipt.Information <= uint64(len(owner.buffer)) {
		owner.receipt.RawBufferHex = hex.EncodeToString(owner.buffer[:int(owner.receipt.Information)])
	}
	var err error
	if owner.receipt.ReturnedStatus != 0 {
		err = fmt.Errorf("bootstrap NtQueryVolumeInformationFile returned %#08x", owner.receipt.ReturnedStatus)
	} else {
		owner.receipt.Flags, owner.receipt.MaximumComponentLength, owner.receipt.FilesystemName, err = earlyBootstrapDecode(owner.receipt.Information, owner.buffer[:])
	}
	owner.pins.Unpin()
	owner.receipt.CloseAttempted = true
	closeErr := owner.closeRoot()
	owner.receipt.RootClosed = closeErr == nil
	if closeErr != nil {
		owner.receipt.CloseError = closeErr.Error()
	}
	err = errors.Join(err, closeErr)
	if err != nil {
		owner.receipt.Error = err.Error()
	}
	return owner.receipt, err
}

func earlyBootstrapCurrentToken(ctx context.Context) (earlyBootstrapToken, error) {
	token, err := (windowsMappings{}).identity(ctx)
	return earlyBootstrapToken{SID: token.SID, AuthenticationID: token.AuthenticationID, SessionID: token.SessionID}, err
}
func earlyBootstrapNative(root string) (earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt, error) {
	receipt := earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt{OpenAccess: win.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES | win.SYNCHRONIZE, OpenShare: win.FILE_SHARE_READ | win.FILE_SHARE_WRITE | win.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, OpenFlags: win.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS}
	if unsafe.Sizeof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}) != 16 || unsafe.Alignof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}.Information) != 8 {
		return receipt, errors.New("bootstrap IO_STATUS_BLOCK ABI differs")
	}
	proc := win.NewLazySystemDLL("ntdll.dll").NewProc("NtQueryVolumeInformationFile")
	if err := proc.Find(); err != nil {
		return receipt, err
	}
	path, err := win.UTF16PtrFromString(root)
	if err != nil {
		return receipt, err
	}
	value, err := win.CreateFile(path, receipt.OpenAccess, receipt.OpenShare, nil, win.OPEN_EXISTING, receipt.OpenFlags, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return receipt, err
	}
	handle := &nativeHandle{value: value}
	receipt.RootOpened = true
	owner := &earlyBootstrapNativeOwner{closeRoot: handle.close, receipt: receipt}
	return earlyBootstrapPerformNative(owner, func(iosb *earlyBootstrapIOSB, buffer *[4096]byte) uint32 {
		status, _, _ := proc.Call(uintptr(handle.value), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(iosb)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(buffer)), uintptr(len(buffer)), 5)
		return uint32(status)
	})
}

func earlyBootstrapExecutable() (string, string, error) {
	path, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	path, err = filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.New()
	_, copyErr := io.Copy(digest, file)
	if err = errors.Join(copyErr, file.Close()); err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	return path, hex.EncodeToString(digest.Sum(nil)), nil
}
func earlyBootstrapRequestValid(request earlyBootstrapRequest) error {
	nonce, err := hex.DecodeString(request.Nonce)
	if err != nil || len(nonce) != 32 {
		return errors.New("bootstrap invocation nonce is invalid")
	}
	if len(request.Root) > 1024 || !strings.HasPrefix(request.Root, `\\`) || strings.ContainsAny(request.Root, "/\x00") {
		return errors.New("bootstrap requires exact root UNC")
	}
	parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(request.Root[2:], `\`), `\`)
	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[0] == "." || parts[0] == "?" || parts[0] == ".." || parts[1] == "" || parts[1] == "." || parts[1] == ".." || strings.Contains(parts[1], ":") {
		return errors.New("bootstrap input contains a descendant path")
	}
	digest, err := hex.DecodeString(request.ExecutableSHA256)
	if err != nil || len(digest) != 32 || !filepath.IsAbs(request.Executable) || request.ParentPID <= 0 || request.Token.SID == "" || len(request.Token.SID) > 256 {
		return errors.New("bootstrap owner identity is incomplete")
	}
	return nil
}
func earlyBootstrapReadJSON(data []byte, target any) error {
	if len(data) == 0 || len(data) > earlyBootstrapLimit {
		return errors.New("bootstrap JSON length outside bound")
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return errors.New("bootstrap has trailing JSON")
	}
	return nil
}
func earlyBootstrapReadInput() (earlyBootstrapRequest, error) {
	var request earlyBootstrapRequest
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, earlyBootstrapLimit+1))
	if err != nil {
		return request, err
	}
	if err = earlyBootstrapReadJSON(data, &request); err != nil {
		return request, err
	}
	return request, earlyBootstrapRequestValid(request)
}
func earlyBootstrapWriteExit(receipt earlyBootstrapChildReceipt, code int) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
	if err != nil || len(data) > earlyBootstrapLimit {
		os.Exit(7)
	}
	if n, err := os.Stdout.Write(data); err != nil || n != len(data) {
		os.Exit(8)
	}
	os.Exit(code)
}
func TestNativeEarlyCapabilityHelper(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("RFS_EARLY_CAPABILITY_HELPER") != "1" {
		return
	}
	request, err := earlyBootstrapReadInput()
	child := earlyBootstrapChildReceipt{Root: request.Root, Nonce: request.Nonce, PID: os.Getpid(), ParentPID: os.Getppid()}
	if err == nil {
		child.Executable, child.ExecutableSHA256, err = earlyBootstrapExecutable()
	}
	if err == nil {
		child.Token, err = earlyBootstrapCurrentToken(context.Background())
	}
	if err == nil && (child.ParentPID != request.ParentPID || child.Token != request.Token || child.Executable != request.Executable || child.ExecutableSHA256 != request.ExecutableSHA256) {
		err = errors.New("bootstrap inherited identity differs from parent")
	}
	if err == nil {
		child.Native, err = earlyBootstrapNative(request.Root)
	}
	code := 0
	if err != nil {
		child.Error = err.Error()
		code = 3
	}
	earlyBootstrapWriteExit(child, code)
}

func earlyBootstrapValidateChild(request earlyBootstrapRequest, pid int, child earlyBootstrapChildReceipt) error {
	if child.Root != request.Root || child.Nonce != request.Nonce || child.PID != pid || child.ParentPID != request.ParentPID || child.Token != request.Token || child.Executable != request.Executable || child.ExecutableSHA256 != request.ExecutableSHA256 {
		return errors.New("bootstrap child binding differs")
	}
	n := child.Native
	if child.Error != "" || n.Error != "" || n.CloseError != "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap child failed: %s / %s / %s", child.Error, n.Error, n.CloseError)
	}
	if !n.RootOpened || !n.CloseAttempted || !n.RootClosed || n.Pending || n.PinsRetained || !n.IOSBPresent || n.IOSBSize != 16 || n.IOSBAlignment != 8 || n.IOSBInformationOffset != 8 || n.ReturnedStatus != 0 || n.OpenAccess != 0x100080 || n.OpenShare != 7 || n.OpenFlags != 0x02000000 {
		return errors.New("bootstrap native completion is not successful and closed")
	}
	raw, err := hex.DecodeString(n.RawBufferHex)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > 4096 || uint64(len(raw)) != n.Information {
		return errors.New("bootstrap native bytes differ from information length")
	}
	flags, component, name, err := earlyBootstrapDecode(n.Information, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if flags != n.Flags || component != n.MaximumComponentLength || name != n.FilesystemName {
		return errors.New("bootstrap decoded fields differ from raw bytes")
	}
	return nil
}

type earlyBootstrapWait struct {
	Confirmed bool
	Err       error
	PID, Code int
	At        time.Time
}
type earlyBootstrapRead struct {
	Stderr []byte
	Data   []byte
	Bytes  int
	Err    error
}
type earlyBootstrapKill struct {
	Attempted bool
	Err       error
}
type earlyBootstrapProcessOwner struct {
	stderr, childStderr                    *os.File
	capture                                *earlyBootstrapCapture
	command                                *exec.Cmd
	input, output, childInput, childOutput *os.File
	started                                chan struct{}
	settled                                chan struct{}
	startErr, pipeErr                      error
	pid                                    int
	waited                                 chan earlyBootstrapWait
	stop                                   chan struct{}
	stopOnce                               sync.Once
	killed                                 chan earlyBootstrapKill
	inputDone                              chan error
	outputDone                             chan earlyBootstrapRead
}

var earlyBootstrapRetained struct {
	sync.Mutex
	owners map[*earlyBootstrapProcessOwner]struct{}
}

func earlyBootstrapRetainProcess(owner *earlyBootstrapProcessOwner) {
	earlyBootstrapRetained.Lock()
	defer earlyBootstrapRetained.Unlock()
	if earlyBootstrapRetained.owners == nil {
		earlyBootstrapRetained.owners = make(map[*earlyBootstrapProcessOwner]struct{})
	}
	earlyBootstrapRetained.owners[owner] = struct{}{}
}
func earlyBootstrapReleaseProcess(owner *earlyBootstrapProcessOwner) {
	earlyBootstrapRetained.Lock()
	defer earlyBootstrapRetained.Unlock()
	delete(earlyBootstrapRetained.owners, owner)
}
func earlyBootstrapWaitResult(command *exec.Cmd, err error) earlyBootstrapWait {
	result := earlyBootstrapWait{Err: err, Code: -1, At: time.Now()}
	if command.Process != nil {
		result.PID = command.Process.Pid
	}
	if command.ProcessState != nil {
		result.Confirmed = true
		result.Code = command.ProcessState.ExitCode()
	}
	if !result.Confirmed && result.Err == nil {
		result.Err = errors.New("bootstrap waiter returned no process state")
	}
	return result
}

type earlyBootstrapCapture struct {
	sync.Mutex
	stdout, stderr []byte
	observed       int
	exceeded       bool
	overflow       chan struct{}
}

func (capture *earlyBootstrapCapture) snapshot(err error) earlyBootstrapRead {
	capture.Lock()
	defer capture.Unlock()
	if capture.exceeded {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New("bootstrap output exceeds shared limit"))
	}
	return earlyBootstrapRead{Data: bytes.Clone(capture.stdout), Stderr: bytes.Clone(capture.stderr), Bytes: capture.observed, Err: err}
}
func (capture *earlyBootstrapCapture) read(file *os.File, stderr bool) error {
	var buffer [1024]byte
	for {
		n, err := file.Read(buffer[:])
		if n > 0 {
			capture.Lock()
			capture.observed += n
			remaining := earlyBootstrapLimit - len(capture.stdout) - len(capture.stderr)
			keep := min(n, remaining)
			if stderr {
				capture.stderr = append(capture.stderr, buffer[:keep]...)
			} else {
				capture.stdout = append(capture.stdout, buffer[:keep]...)
			}
			excess := n > remaining
			if excess && !capture.exceeded {
				capture.exceeded = true
				close(capture.overflow)
			}
			capture.Unlock()
			if excess {
				return errors.Join(errors.New("bootstrap output exceeds shared limit"), earlyBootstrapClosePipe(file))
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
				err = nil
			}
			return errors.Join(err, earlyBootstrapClosePipe(file))
		}
	}
}
func earlyBootstrapNewOwner(command *exec.Cmd, input []byte) (*earlyBootstrapProcessOwner, error) {
	childInput, parentInput, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	parentOutput, childOutput, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, childInput.Close(), parentInput.Close())
	}
	parentStderr, childStderr, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, childInput.Close(), parentInput.Close(), parentOutput.Close(), childOutput.Close())
	}
	owner := &earlyBootstrapProcessOwner{stderr: parentStderr, childStderr: childStderr, capture: &earlyBootstrapCapture{overflow: make(chan struct{})}, command: command, input: parentInput, output: parentOutput, childInput: childInput, childOutput: childOutput, started: make(chan struct{}), settled: make(chan struct{}), waited: make(chan earlyBootstrapWait, 1), stop: make(chan struct{}), killed: make(chan earlyBootstrapKill, 1), inputDone: make(chan error, 1), outputDone: make(chan earlyBootstrapRead, 1)}
	command.Stdin = childInput
	command.Stdout = childOutput
	command.Stderr = childStderr
	earlyBootstrapRetainProcess(owner)
	go func() {
		owner.startErr = command.Start()
		owner.pipeErr = errors.Join(childInput.Close(), childOutput.Close(), childStderr.Close())
		if owner.startErr == nil {
			owner.pid = command.Process.Pid
		}
		close(owner.started)
		if owner.startErr != nil {
			close(owner.settled)
			return
		}
		err := command.Wait()
		result := earlyBootstrapWaitResult(command, err)
		owner.waited <- result
		if result.Confirmed {
			close(owner.settled)
		}
	}()
	go func() {
		select {
		case <-owner.stop:
		case <-owner.settled:
			owner.killed <- earlyBootstrapKill{}
			return
		}
		<-owner.started
		if owner.startErr != nil {
			owner.killed <- earlyBootstrapKill{}
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-owner.settled:
			owner.killed <- earlyBootstrapKill{}
			return
		default:
		}
		owner.killed <- earlyBootstrapKill{Attempted: true, Err: command.Process.Kill()}
	}()
	go func() {
		_, err := io.Copy(parentInput, bytes.NewReader(input))
		closeErr := parentInput.Close()
		owner.inputDone <- errors.Join(err, closeErr)
	}()
	streamDone := make(chan error, 2)
	go func() { streamDone <- owner.capture.read(parentOutput, false) }()
	go func() { streamDone <- owner.capture.read(parentStderr, true) }()
	go func() {
		err := errors.Join(<-streamDone, <-streamDone)
		owner.outputDone <- owner.capture.snapshot(err)
	}()

	return owner, nil
}

func earlyBootstrapClosePipe(file *os.File) error {
	err := file.Close()
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) {
		return nil
	}
	return err
}
func earlyBootstrapSupervise(ctx context.Context, command *exec.Cmd, request earlyBootstrapRequest, budget, drain time.Duration) (earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt, error) {
	receipt := earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt{Nonce: request.Nonce, Root: request.Root, Executable: request.Executable, ExecutableSHA256: request.ExecutableSHA256, ParentPID: request.ParentPID, ParentToken: request.Token, Started: time.Now(), ExitCode: -1}
	failBeforeLaunch := func(err error) (earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt, error) {
		receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_admission_failed"
		receipt.Error = err.Error()
		return receipt, err
	}
	if err := earlyBootstrapRequestValid(request); err != nil {
		return failBeforeLaunch(err)
	}
	if budget <= 0 || drain <= 0 || command.Path != request.Executable || len(command.ExtraFiles) != 0 || command.Stdin != nil || command.Stdout != nil || command.Stderr != nil {
		return failBeforeLaunch(errors.New("bootstrap command ownership differs"))
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return failBeforeLaunch(err)
	}
	input, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return failBeforeLaunch(err)
	}
	if len(input) > earlyBootstrapLimit {
		return failBeforeLaunch(errors.New("bootstrap input exceeds limit"))
	}
	receipt.InputBytes = len(input)
	deadline := receipt.Started.Add(budget)
	owner, err := earlyBootstrapNewOwner(command, input)
	if err != nil {
		return failBeforeLaunch(err)
	}
	receipt.owner = owner
	receipt.OwnerRetained = true
	started, waited, inputDone, outputDone := false, false, false, false
	startCh, waitCh, inCh, outCh := owner.started, owner.waited, owner.inputDone, owner.outputDone
	var child earlyBootstrapChildReceipt
	var failure error
	work := time.NewTimer(time.Until(deadline))
	defer work.Stop()
	recordWait := func(result earlyBootstrapWait) {
		waited = result.Confirmed
		waitCh = nil
		receipt.PID = result.PID
		receipt.ExitConfirmed = result.Confirmed
		if !result.Confirmed {
			failure = errors.Join(result.Err, errors.New("bootstrap process exit is unconfirmed"))
			receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_wait_unconfirmed"
		}
		receipt.WaitReturned = result.At
		if result.Confirmed {
			receipt.Exited = result.At
		}
		receipt.ExitCode = result.Code
		if result.Err != nil {
			receipt.WaitError = result.Err.Error()
		}
	}
	recordRaw := func(result earlyBootstrapRead) {
		receipt.Stdout = result.Data
		receipt.Stderr = result.Stderr
		receipt.OutputBytes = result.Bytes
		receipt.OutputComplete = result.Err == nil
	}
	recordOutput := func(result earlyBootstrapRead) error {
		recordRaw(result)
		parseErr := earlyBootstrapReadJSON(result.Data, &child)
		if parseErr == nil {
			receipt.ChildToken = child.Token
			receipt.Native = &child.Native
		}
		var stderrErr error
		if len(result.Stderr) != 0 {
			stderrErr = errors.New("bootstrap helper wrote stderr")
		}
		return errors.Join(result.Err, parseErr, stderrErr)
	}
	for failure == nil {
		if started && outputDone {
			if err := earlyBootstrapValidateChild(request, receipt.PID, child); err != nil {
				failure = err
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_invalid_receipt"
				if child.Native.Pending {
					receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_unexpected_pending"
				}
				break
			}
		}
		if started && inputDone && outputDone && waited {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				failure = ctx.Err()
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_cancelled"
			} else if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
				failure = context.DeadlineExceeded
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_deadline"
			} else if receipt.ExitCode != 0 || receipt.WaitError != "" {
				failure = fmt.Errorf("bootstrap helper exit: %s", receipt.WaitError)
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_child_failed"
			} else if err := earlyBootstrapValidateChild(request, receipt.PID, child); err != nil {
				failure = err
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_invalid_receipt"
			} else {
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_complete"
				earlyBootstrapReleaseProcess(owner)
				receipt.owner = nil
				receipt.OwnerRetained = false
				return receipt, nil
			}
			break
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			failure = ctx.Err()
			receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_cancelled"
		case <-work.C:
			failure = context.DeadlineExceeded
			receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_deadline"
		case <-owner.capture.overflow:
			failure = errors.New("bootstrap output exceeds shared limit")
			receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_output_failed"
		case <-startCh:
			started = true
			startCh = nil
			receipt.PID = owner.pid
			if owner.startErr != nil {
				failure = owner.startErr
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_start_failed"
			} else if owner.pipeErr != nil {
				failure = owner.pipeErr
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_pipe_failed"
			}
		case result := <-waitCh:
			recordWait(result)
		case err := <-inCh:
			inputDone = true
			inCh = nil
			if err != nil {
				failure = err
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_input_failed"
			}
		case result := <-outCh:
			outputDone = true
			outCh = nil
			if err := recordOutput(result); err != nil {
				failure = err
				receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_invalid_receipt"
			}
		}
	}
	receipt.Error = failure.Error()
	if !waited && !(started && owner.startErr != nil) {
		receipt.KillRequested = true
		owner.stopOnce.Do(func() { close(owner.stop) })
	}
	termination := time.NewTimer(drain)
	defer termination.Stop()
	killCh := owner.killed
	killDone := !receipt.KillRequested
	recordKill := func(result earlyBootstrapKill) {
		killDone = true
		killCh = nil
		receipt.KillAttempted = result.Attempted
		receipt.KillReturned = result.Attempted
		if result.Err != nil {
			receipt.KillError = result.Err.Error()
		}
	}
	unsettled := func() (earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt, error) {
		recordRaw(owner.capture.snapshot(errors.New("bootstrap pipe capture is incomplete")))
		receipt.Outcome = "bootstrap_cleanup_unsettled"
		failure = errors.Join(failure, errors.New(receipt.Outcome))
		receipt.Error = failure.Error()
		return receipt, failure
	}
	for !waited && !(started && owner.startErr != nil) {
		select {
		case <-startCh:
			started = true
			startCh = nil
			receipt.PID = owner.pid
		case result := <-waitCh:
			recordWait(result)
		case result := <-killCh:
			recordKill(result)
		case <-termination.C:
			return unsettled()
		}
	}
	failure = errors.Join(failure, earlyBootstrapClosePipe(owner.input))
	for !inputDone || !outputDone || !killDone {
		select {
		case err := <-inCh:
			inputDone = true
			inCh = nil
			failure = errors.Join(failure, err)
		case result := <-outCh:
			outputDone = true
			outCh = nil
			failure = errors.Join(failure, recordOutput(result))
		case result := <-killCh:
			recordKill(result)
		case <-termination.C:
			return unsettled()
		}
	}
	failure = errors.Join(failure, earlyBootstrapClosePipe(owner.output), earlyBootstrapClosePipe(owner.stderr))
	receipt.Error = failure.Error()

	earlyBootstrapReleaseProcess(owner)
	receipt.owner = nil
	receipt.OwnerRetained = false
	return receipt, failure
}

func earlyBootstrapRun(ctx context.Context, root string) (earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt, error) {
	executable, digest, err := earlyBootstrapExecutable()
	if err != nil {
		return earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt{Outcome: "bootstrap_setup_failed", Error: err.Error()}, err
	}
	token, err := earlyBootstrapCurrentToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt{Outcome: "bootstrap_setup_failed", Error: err.Error()}, err
	}
	var nonce [32]byte
	if _, err = rand.Read(nonce[:]); err != nil {
		return earlyBootstrapProcessReceipt{Outcome: "bootstrap_setup_failed", Error: err.Error()}, err
	}
	request := earlyBootstrapRequest{Nonce: hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:]), Root: root, ParentPID: os.Getpid(), Executable: executable, ExecutableSHA256: digest, Token: token}
	command := exec.Command(executable, "-test.run=^TestNativeEarlyCapabilityHelper$", "-test.count=1")
	for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(entry, "RFS_EARLY_CAPABILITY_HELPER=") {
			command.Env = append(command.Env, entry)
		}
	}
	command.Env = append(command.Env, "RFS_EARLY_CAPABILITY_HELPER=1")
	return earlyBootstrapSupervise(ctx, command, request, 10*time.Second, 5*time.Second)
}

func earlyBootstrapControlBytes() []byte {
	return []byte{6, 4, 0, 0, 255, 0, 0, 0, 18, 0, 0, 0, 'r', 0, 'e', 0, 'm', 0, 'o', 0, 't', 0, 'e', 0, '-', 0, 'f', 0, 's', 0}
}
func earlyBootstrapControlQuery(mode string) (earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt, error) {
	closed := 0
	owner := &earlyBootstrapNativeOwner{receipt: earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt{RootOpened: true, OpenAccess: 0x100080, OpenShare: 7, OpenFlags: 0x02000000}, closeRoot: func() error {
		closed++
		if mode == "close-error" {
			return errors.New("controlled root close failure")
		}
		return nil
	}}
	receipt, err := earlyBootstrapPerformNative(owner, func(iosb *earlyBootstrapIOSB, buffer *[4096]byte) uint32 {
		if mode == "blocked" {
			for {
				time.Sleep(time.Hour)
			}
		}
		if mode == "pending" {
			active := make(chan struct{})
			go func() {
				iosb.Status = 1
				close(active)
				for {
					iosb.Status++
					iosb.Information++
					buffer[0]++
					time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
				}
			}()
			<-active
			return earlyBootstrapPending
		}
		copy(buffer[:], earlyBootstrapControlBytes())
		iosb.Information = 30
		iosb.Status = 0xc0000001
		if mode == "native-error" {
			iosb.Status = 0
			return 0xc0000001
		}
		if mode == "overflow" {
			return 0x80000005
		}
		if mode == "bad-information" {
			iosb.Information = 4097
		}
		return 0
	})
	if mode == "pending" {
		if earlyBootstrapPendingOwner != owner || !receipt.PinsRetained || receipt.IOSBPresent || closed != 0 {
			panic("pending owner was released")
		}
	} else if closed != 1 || receipt.PinsRetained {
		panic("terminal query did not release exactly once")
	}
	return receipt, err
}
func TestEarlyBootstrapProcessControlHelper(t *testing.T) {
	mode := os.Getenv("RFS_EARLY_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL")
	if mode == "" {
		return
	}
	request, err := earlyBootstrapReadInput()
	if err != nil {
		os.Exit(11)
	}
	if mode == "lost" {
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	if mode == "malformed" {
		_, _ = os.Stdout.Write([]byte("{"))
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	if mode == "oversized" {
		_, _ = os.Stdout.Write(bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), earlyBootstrapLimit+1))
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	if mode == "mixed-oversized" {
		_, _ = os.Stdout.Write(bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), earlyBootstrapLimit/2))
		_, _ = os.Stderr.Write(bytes.Repeat([]byte("y"), earlyBootstrapLimit/2+1))
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	if mode == "stderr" {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.Write([]byte("controlled stderr"))
	}

	child := earlyBootstrapChildReceipt{Root: request.Root, Nonce: request.Nonce, PID: os.Getpid(), ParentPID: os.Getppid(), Token: request.Token}
	child.Executable, child.ExecutableSHA256, err = earlyBootstrapExecutable()
	if err != nil {
		os.Exit(12)
	}
	child.Native, err = earlyBootstrapControlQuery(mode)
	if err != nil {
		child.Error = err.Error()
	}
	switch mode {
	case "wrong-root":
		child.Root += "A"
	case "wrong-pid":
		child.PID++
	case "wrong-parent":
		child.ParentPID++
	case "wrong-nonce":
		child.Nonce = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	case "wrong-token":
		child.Token.AuthenticationID++
	case "wrong-session":
		child.Token.SessionID++
	case "wrong-sid":
		child.Token.SID += "-1"
	case "wrong-hash":
		child.ExecutableSHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	case "wrong-path":
		child.Executable += ".other"
	case "receipt-then-block":
		data, _ := json.Marshal(child)
		_, _ = os.Stdout.Write(data)
		_ = os.Stdout.Close()
		_ = os.Stderr.Close()
		for {
			time.Sleep(time.Hour)
		}
	}
	code := 0
	if err != nil {
		code = 3
	}
	earlyBootstrapWriteExit(child, code)
}
func earlyBootstrapControlRequest(t *testing.T) earlyBootstrapRequest {
	t.Helper()
	executable, digest, err := earlyBootstrapExecutable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var nonce [32]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce[:]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return earlyBootstrapRequest{Nonce: hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:]), Root: `\\127.0.0.1\private-share\`, ParentPID: os.Getpid(), Executable: executable, ExecutableSHA256: digest, Token: earlyBootstrapToken{SID: "portable-token-model", AuthenticationID: 19, SessionID: 2}}
}
func earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request earlyBootstrapRequest, mode string) *exec.Cmd {
	command := exec.Command(request.Executable, "-test.run=^TestEarlyBootstrapProcessControlHelper$", "-test.count=1")
	for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(entry, "RFS_EARLY_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL=") {
			command.Env = append(command.Env, entry)
		}
	}
	command.Env = append(command.Env, "RFS_EARLY_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL="+mode)
	return command
}
func TestEarlyBootstrapProcessControls(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"success", "lost", "malformed", "oversized", "mixed-oversized", "stderr", "wrong-root", "wrong-pid", "wrong-parent", "wrong-nonce", "wrong-token", "wrong-session", "wrong-sid", "wrong-hash", "wrong-path", "native-error", "overflow", "bad-information", "close-error", "pending", "blocked", "receipt-then-block"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := earlyBootstrapControlRequest(t)
			command := earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request, mode)
			budget := 5 * time.Second
			if mode == "blocked" || mode == "receipt-then-block" {
				budget = 200 * time.Millisecond
			}
			receipt, err := earlyBootstrapSupervise(t.Context(), command, request, budget, 2*time.Second)
			if len(receipt.Stdout)+len(receipt.Stderr) > earlyBootstrapLimit {
				t.Fatal("raw streams exceed shared bound")
			}
			if mode == "stderr" {
				if !bytes.Equal(receipt.Stderr, []byte("controlled stderr")) || len(receipt.Stdout) == 0 {
					t.Fatal("raw stderr/stdout lost", receipt)
				}
			} else if mode != "mixed-oversized" && len(receipt.Stderr) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected child stderr: %s", receipt.Stderr)
			}
			if mode == "malformed" && !bytes.Equal(receipt.Stdout, []byte("{")) {
				t.Fatal("malformed helper bytes lost", receipt.Stdout)
			}
			if mode == "mixed-oversized" && (len(receipt.Stdout)+len(receipt.Stderr) != earlyBootstrapLimit || receipt.OutputBytes <= earlyBootstrapLimit || receipt.OutputComplete) {
				t.Fatal("shared stream overflow hidden", receipt)
			}
			if mode == "success" {
				if err != nil || !receipt.ExitConfirmed || receipt.ExitCode != 0 || receipt.KillRequested || receipt.Native == nil || receipt.Native.IOSBStatus != 0xc0000001 || !receipt.Native.RootClosed {
					t.Fatalf("terminal returned-status semantics: %+v %v", receipt, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s became success: %+v", mode, receipt)
			}
			if !receipt.ExitConfirmed || receipt.PID <= 0 || receipt.owner != nil {
				t.Fatalf("child exit not owned/confirmed: %+v %v", receipt, err)
			}
			if mode == "oversized" && receipt.OutputBytes != earlyBootstrapLimit+1 {
				t.Fatal("oversized output length hidden", receipt.OutputBytes)
			}
			if mode == "pending" && (receipt.Native == nil || !receipt.Native.PinsRetained || receipt.Native.RootClosed || receipt.Native.IOSBPresent) {
				t.Fatal("pending completion decoded/released", receipt.Native)
			}
			if (mode == "blocked" || mode == "receipt-then-block") && (!receipt.KillRequested || receipt.ExitCode == 0) {
				t.Fatal("receipt or Kill was treated as process exit", receipt)
			}
			earlyBootstrapRetained.Lock()
			owners := len(earlyBootstrapRetained.owners)
			earlyBootstrapRetained.Unlock()
			if owners != 0 {
				t.Fatal("settled process owner retained", owners)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEarlyBootstrapNativeParsing(t *testing.T) {
	if unsafe.Sizeof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}) != 16 || unsafe.Alignof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(earlyBootstrapIOSB{}.Information) != 8 {
		t.Fatal("wrong IOSB ABI")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"success", "short-header", "oversized-information", "truncated-name", "odd-name", "bad-utf16", "wrong-flags", "wrong-component", "wrong-name"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			data := earlyBootstrapControlBytes()
			info := uint64(len(data))
			switch name {
			case "short-header":
				info = 11
			case "oversized-information":
				info = 4097
			case "truncated-name":
				info--
			case "odd-name":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[8:], 17)
			case "bad-utf16":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[12:], 0xd800)
			case "wrong-flags":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data, 6)
			case "wrong-component":
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[4:], 254)
			case "wrong-name":
				data[12] = 'x'
			}
			flags, component, fsname, err := earlyBootstrapDecode(info, data)
			if name == "success" {
				if err != nil || flags != 0x406 || component != 255 || fsname != "remote-fs" {
					t.Fatal(flags, component, fsname, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed native buffer accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, status := range []uint32{0, 0xc0000001, 0x80000005} {
		closes := 0
		owner := &earlyBootstrapNativeOwner{receipt: earlyBootstrapNativeReceipt{RootOpened: true}, closeRoot: func() error { closes++; return nil }}
		receipt, err := earlyBootstrapPerformNative(owner, func(iosb *earlyBootstrapIOSB, buffer *[4096]byte) uint32 {
			copy(buffer[:], earlyBootstrapControlBytes())
			iosb.Information = 30
			if status == 0 {
				iosb.Status = 0xc0000001
			}
			return status
		})
		if (status == 0) != (err == nil) || closes != 1 || !receipt.RootClosed || receipt.PinsRetained {
			t.Fatal("returned status/terminal ownership changed", receipt, err, closes)
		}
	}
}
func TestEarlyBootstrapAdmissionAndJSON(t *testing.T) {
	request := earlyBootstrapControlRequest(t)
	for _, root := range []string{`\\127.0.0.1\private-share`, `\\127.0.0.1\private-share\`} {
		request.Root = root
		if err := earlyBootstrapRequestValid(request); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for _, root := range []string{`\\127.0.0.1\private-share\A`, `\\127.0.0.1\private-share\B`, `\\127.0.0.1\private-share\\`, `C:\root`, `\\.\PhysicalDrive0`, `\\?\volume`, `\\127.0.0.1\`, "\\\\127.0.0.1\\share\x00"} {
		request.Root = root
		if err := earlyBootstrapRequestValid(request); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("non-root input admitted", root)
		}
	}
	for _, raw := range [][]byte{nil, []byte(`{"unknown":1}`), []byte(`{} {}`), bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), earlyBootstrapLimit+1)} {
		var got earlyBootstrapChildReceipt
		if err := earlyBootstrapReadJSON(raw, &got); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid bounded receipt admitted")
		}
	}
	request = earlyBootstrapControlRequest(t)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	cancel()
	receipt, err := earlyBootstrapSupervise(ctx, earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request, "success"), request, time.Second, time.Second)
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || receipt.PID != 0 || receipt.KillRequested {
		t.Fatal("cancelled admission launched helper", receipt, err)
	}
	command := earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request, "success")
	command.Path += ".missing"
	receipt, err = earlyBootstrapSupervise(t.Context(), command, request, time.Second, time.Second)
	if err == nil || receipt.PID != 0 {
		t.Fatal("different executable admitted", receipt, err)
	}
	request.Executable += ".missing"
	command = earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request, "success")
	receipt, err = earlyBootstrapSupervise(t.Context(), command, request, time.Second, time.Second)
	if err == nil || receipt.ExitConfirmed || receipt.PID != 0 || receipt.owner != nil {
		t.Fatal("failed launch manufactured process exit", receipt, err)
	}
	request = earlyBootstrapControlRequest(t)
	request.Executable = string(os.PathSeparator) + strings.Repeat("x", earlyBootstrapLimit)
	command = earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request, "success")
	receipt, err = earlyBootstrapSupervise(t.Context(), command, request, time.Second, time.Second)
	if err == nil || receipt.PID != 0 {
		t.Fatal("oversized invocation admitted", receipt, err)
	}
}
func TestEarlyBootstrapCancellationAndDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"cancel", "deadline"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := earlyBootstrapControlRequest(t)
			command := earlyBootstrapControlCommand(request, "blocked")
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
			defer cancel()
			budget := 5 * time.Second
			if name == "cancel" {
				timer := time.AfterFunc(200*time.Millisecond, cancel)
				defer timer.Stop()
			} else {
				budget = time.Nanosecond
			}
			receipt, err := earlyBootstrapSupervise(ctx, command, request, budget, 2*time.Second)
			if err == nil || !receipt.ExitConfirmed || !receipt.KillRequested || receipt.PID <= 0 || receipt.owner != nil || receipt.ExitCode == 0 {
				t.Fatal("cancel/deadline became success or lost owner", receipt, err)
			}
			if name == "cancel" && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if name == "deadline" && !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEarlyBootstrapWaitRequiresProcessState(t *testing.T) {
	for _, err := range []error{nil, errors.New("controlled process wait failure")} {
		result := earlyBootstrapWaitResult(&exec.Cmd{}, err)
		if result.Confirmed || result.Code != -1 || result.Err == nil {
			t.Fatal("unknown waiter result became exit proof", result)
		}
	}
}
